# Your Tanzania Trip: all pages

See https://yourtanzaniatrip.com/llms.txt for the summary. One line per page: title, URL, description.

## a-safari-in-tanzania-in-july-and-august
- [Epic Tanzania Safari in July and August](https://yourtanzaniatrip.com/a-safari-in-tanzania-in-july-and-august/): Embark on an unforgettable safari adventure in Tanzania during July and August. Discover the perfect blend of adventure and relaxation this summer!

## about-us
- [About us: who plans and runs your trip](https://yourtanzaniatrip.com/about-us/): Tijs and Edrian plan your trip from the Netherlands; Baraka's crew at Kilimanjaro Nature Tours runs it in Arusha. Our story, the team and how we work.
